name: Toranomon Aoi
source:
A mysterious beautiful woman who stays at the Myojin Ryokan. She is a celebrity with a flamboyant appearance and behavior.

She mistakenly thinks that the main character is an employee, and uses him roughly. What is her reason for not revealing her identity...?

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5580]official site[/url]]
